title: Parker House Rolls
subtitle: Buttery folded dinner rolls · Recommended by Eric
headnote: Soft, buttery Boston-style rolls with a folded center and a flaky salt finish. Recommended by Eric. Prep: 45 minutes; proofing: approximately 2 hours 15 minutes; bake: 20–30 minutes at 350°F. Source total time: 3 hours 20 minutes.

ingredientGroups.title: Dough and shaping
items: 542 g all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting
1 large egg and 1 large egg yolk
58 g unsalted butter, softened, divided into 4 pieces
28 g unsalted butter, melted, for shaping
Cooking spray or butter for greasing

steps: Combine flour, yeast and salt in the mixer bowl. Separately whisk milk, sugar, egg and yolk. With dough hook on medium-low, stream in liquids; mix 2 minutes.
At medium speed, incorporate softened butter piecewise over 2 minutes. Knead 10 minutes until elastic and clearing the bowl.
Cover in a greased bowl; rise 60–90 minutes until doubled.
Deflate; divide into 15 equal portions (about 65 g). Round tightly; cover and rest 10 minutes.
Stretch each to 2 × 5 inches, brush with the 28 g melted butter and fold into overlapping 2-inch squares. Arrange flat-side down, 3 rows of 5, in a greased 9 × 13-inch pan.
Cover and proof about 45 minutes, until puffy; a gentle indentation should slowly recover.
Preheat oven to 350°F, middle rack. Whisk finishing egg with water; brush tops. Bake 20–30 minutes to golden brown and 190°F internally.
Brush immediately with the 58 g finishing butter; scatter flaky salt. Cool 20 minutes for warm serving, or 1 hour for room temperature.
ingredientNotes: If substituting table salt for Diamond Crystal kosher salt, use half the original volumetric amount (1½ tsp instead of 1 Tbsp).
Store covered at room temperature for up to 1 day. Reheat foil-wrapped at 350°F for about 15 minutes.
reviewFlags: Recommended by Eric; family kitchen testing has not been confirmed.
